description: Add the service component to the throughput-Jain reward with equal coefficients. This round asks what service contributes before any coefficient tuning.

common.reward_normalization: All three positive components use their existing bounded scores. Delta rewards, standalone penalties and Lagrangian multipliers remain disabled so the result is attributable to adding the service component.

cases.label: Equal throughput + Jain fairness + service
cases.hypothesis: Does adding the service score with the same coefficient as throughput and Jain reduce starvation or waiting time, and what does it cost in goodput and fairness?
